HTTP response body (JSON) from the request below, the "result" array entry for isoCode "ES" / type "STANDARD", quoted verbatim:
{
    "countryName" : "Spain",
    "isoCode" : "ES",
    "historized" : null,
    "type" : "STANDARD",
    "rates" : [ {
      "key" : null,
      "value" : 7.0,
      "situationOn" : "2026/07/01",
      "cnCodes" : null,
      "cpaCodes" : null,
      "category" : null,
      "comments" : "VAT - Canary Islands - "
    }, {
      "key" : null,
      "value" : 21.0,
      "situationOn" : "2026/07/01",
      "cnCodes" : null,
      "cpaCodes" : null,
      "category" : null,
      "comments" : null
    } ]
  }

notes: Standard VAT rate read directly from the European Commission's Taxes in Europe Database (TEDB, DG TAXUD) — the source root TODO item 16's own OSS block names as the one to use. Consulted 2026-09-01 via the SAME public request the TEDB web app itself issues: POST https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/tedb/rest-api/vatSearch {"searchForm":{"selectedMemberStates":[10],"dateFrom":null,"dateTo":"2026/09/01","selectedCategories":null,"selectedCnCodes":[],"selectedCpaCodes":[]}} — HTTP 200, the exact JSON record quoted verbatim in `provenance.sourceText` above (member-state id 10 = isoCode "ES" in TEDB's own numbering, confirmed empirically by querying each id 1..30 in turn and reading back which isoCode it returns). Interactive equivalent: https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/tedb/#/vat-search (VAT Search form) → country Spain, To=2026/09/01, then VAT Search Results. TEDB's own `situationOn` for this rate is "2026/07/01" (the date the CURRENTLY-in-force rate took effect — always ≤ today, since the search was run with no `dateFrom` and `dateTo` = today, which TEDB's own "Please click here to display the search rules" panel documents as returning "the rates applicable in the... selected Countries today"). This STANDARD record carries TWO distinct rate entries for `situationOn` "2026/07/01": one at 7% commented "VAT - Canary Islands - " (the Canary Islands run their own indirect tax territory, IGIC, outside the EU VAT area — the Canary Islands' 7% is NOT the Spanish VAT standard rate), and one at 21% with NO comment (mainland Spain's own general VAT standard rate, Ley 37/1992 in TEDB's own domain but not itself read here — TEDB IS the sourced fact for this task, per its own brief). `standardRate` = 21, the uncommented (general/mainland) entry — not the Canary Islands figure, which this catalog does not model (no subdivision field for it, same reasoning `us.json` gives for not modeling every US county's own sales-tax layer). reducedRates are DELIBERATELY not modeled here even though TEDB also returns them: `documents/tax/tax-engine.ts#ossDestinationVat` (the ONE consumer this table exists to unblock, per `resolve-invoice-tax.ts`'s own header, "OSS with no destination rate table") reads only `dest.standardRate` — never `reducedRates` — and `DocumentLine` (`documents/tax/types.ts`) carries no per-line product category a reduced rate could even be selected against. Adding an unconsumed reducedRates array would be data with no reader, not a real capability — see this task's own brief.
